definition: Force out your opponent while maintaining a grip on their mawashi.
Push out your opponent without gripping the mawashi.
Slap down an opponent as they move forward.
Overarm throw using an outside grip on the mawashi.
Underarm throw using an inside grip on the mawashi.
Thrust down an opponent to the clay.
Push out an opponent from behind.
Arm lock throw, trapping the opponent's arm and rolling them to the ground.
Beltless arm throw using a scooping motion under the opponent's arm.
Force out and down while staying chest-to-chest with the opponent.
Force out using repeated palm thrusts to the chest or face without gripping the mawashi.
Thrust down the opponent to the dohyo surface using palm strikes.
Push the opponent directly to the ground rather than out of the ring.
Lean the full body weight forward onto the opponent, crushing them to the clay.
Hoist the opponent entirely off the ground by the mawashi and carry them out of the ring.
Pull down the opponent by the arm, shoulder, or mawashi, causing them to fall forward.
Pulling overarm throw using an outside mawashi grip to drag the opponent to the ground.
Pulling underarm throw using an inside mawashi grip to pull the opponent down.
Neck throw wrapping an arm around the opponent's neck or head to throw them to the ground.
Hip throw where the attacker bends under the opponent and flips them over their hip.
One-armed shoulder throw where the attacker ducks under and flips the opponent over one shoulder.
Arm-bar twist grabbing the opponent's wrist and elbow to force them down sideways.
Outside leg trip wrapping the calf around the outside of the opponent's leg to drive them backward.
Inside leg trip hooking a leg around the inside of the opponent's leg to topple them.
Leg pick grabbing one of the opponent's legs to strip their footing and force them down.
Ankle sweep at the tachiai, kicking the opponent's ankle outward while thrusting forward.
Twisting backward knee trip placing a leg behind the opponent's knee and sweeping them over it.
Thigh-grabbing push-down gripping under the opponent's thigh with one hand while shoving with the other.
Overarm belt twist-down grabbing the mawashi over the opponent's arm and twisting them to the ground.
Underarm belt twist-down grabbing the mawashi under the opponent's arm and pulling them forward to the ground.
Torso twist-down reacting to the opponent's charge and twisting their off-balance body to the surface.
Shoulder pull-down wrapping one hand around the opponent's arm and pushing their shoulder to tip them over.
Backward pivot counter-throw where a wrestler on the ring's edge bends back and twists a charging opponent out.
Rear throw-down hurling a behind-facing opponent sideways to the ground.
Rear push-down knocking a behind-facing opponent to the dohyo surface.
Forward force-down grabbing the mawashi and pulling sharply outward and down until the opponent's knees touch the clay.
Arm-grabbing pull twist hooking the opponent's arm from inside and dragging or twisting them down.
Arm-lock force-out immobilizing both of the opponent's arms and driving them out of the ring.
Hooking inner-thigh throw lifting the opponent's thigh with a leg while grasping their body.
Outer-thigh scoop grabbing the opponent's outer thigh after a throw attempt and tipping them backward.
